newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi raises Dec Super Light to Asia by 35cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Saudi raises Dec Super Light to Asia by 35cts/bbl.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has raised the price formula for December-lifting Arab Super Light crude to Asian customers by 35 cents per barrel, traders said on Tuesday.
The December term contract price for Arab Super Light was set at the Oman/Dubai differential plus $2.75, compared with $2.40 for November, traders said.

Saudi Arabia earlier said it had raised its December price formula for Arab Light and Extra Light crude to Asian customers by 15 to 30 cents per barrel, while lowering Arab Heavy crude by 10 cents. December Arab Medium was unchanged from November.
